title: Rapeseed peptide inhibits HepG2 cell proliferation by regulating the mitochondrial and P53 signaling pathways.
authors: Ma, Keer; Wang, Zhigao; Ju, Xingrong; Huang, Jiankang; He, Rong
journal: Journal of the science of food and agriculture
one_liner_zh: 研究菜籽肽抑制肝癌细胞增殖的细胞实验与信号通路，仅涉及肽-MDM2分子对接，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Rapeseed peptide, extracted from rapeseed protein, is known to have a variety of biological activities. In this study, the anti-proliferation effect and molecular mechanism of rapeseed peptide on HepG2 cells were investigated. RESULTS: In vitro anticancer experiments showed that the rapeseed peptide NDGNQPL could inhibit HepG2 cell proliferation in a concentration-dependent manner [half maximal inhibitory concentration (IC(50) ), 1.56 mmol L(-1) ). HepG2 cells were induced by NDGNQPL at a 0.5 mmol L(-1) concentration and exhibited a 28.39 +/- 0.80% apoptosis rate and a cell cycle arrest in the G0/G1 phase. Meanwhile, rapeseed peptide induced a decrease in mitochondrial membrane potential, an increase in reactive oxygen species (ROS) release, and changes in the nuclear morphology of HepG2 cells, indicating that rapeseed peptide could induce cell apoptosis through the mitochondrial pathway. In addition, rapeseed peptide activated the proliferation-related P53 signaling pathway, in which the expression levels of P53, P21, and cleaved-caspase3 were up-regulated, while the expression levels of murine double minute 2 (MDM2) were down-regulated. In molecular docking simulations, NDGNQPL exhibited a good affinity for the MDM2 molecule, which supported the notion that the rapeseed peptide is able to inhibit MDM2, a negative regulator of P53. CONCLUSION: The current results indicate that the rapeseed-derived NDGNQPL peptide has the potential to inhibit the proliferation of HepG2 cells and promote human health. abstract_zh: 背景：菜籽肽是从菜籽蛋白中提取的，已知具有多种生物活性。本研究探讨了菜籽肽对HepG2细胞的抗增殖作用及其分子机制。结果：体外抗癌实验表明，菜籽肽NDGNQPL能以浓度依赖性方式抑制HepG2细胞增殖[半数抑制浓度（IC(50)）为1.56 mmol L(-1)]。HepG2细胞在0.5 mmol L(-1)浓度的NDGNQPL诱导下，表现出28.39 ± 0.80%的凋亡率和G0/G1期细胞周期阻滞。同时，菜籽肽诱导了线粒体膜电位下降、活性氧（ROS）释放增加以及HepG2细胞核形态变化，表明菜籽肽可通过线粒体途径诱导细胞凋亡。此外，菜籽肽激活了与增殖相关的P53信号通路，其中P53、P21和cleaved-caspase3的表达水平上调，而鼠双微体2（MDM2）的表达水平下调。在分子对接模拟中，NDGNQPL对MDM2分子表现出良好的亲和力，这支持了菜籽肽能够抑制MDM2（P53的负调控因子）的观点。结论：当前结果表明，菜籽来源的NDGNQPL肽具有抑制HepG2细胞增殖并促进人类健康的潜力。(c) 2022 化学工业学会。
